nodes.long_description:
VAIL is a 5v5 tactical shooter game developed from the ground-up for virtual reality.

Immersive Physics:
Guns collide with the environment. Throw magazines to teammates, bounce grenades around corners, climb ladders, vault over obstacles, ride ziplines, defy gravity on jump pads, and more.

Competitive Integrity:
Everything in VAIL is designed to uphold competitive integrity. From standardizing player height, to preventing play space cheats; trust that every match will be competitive and fair.

Social Experiences (in development):
After a fast-paced match, challenge friends to mini-games in the social hub, flex gun and avatar skins, or 1v1 a friend. Customizable home, game modes and experiences in development.
nodes.short_description: VAIL VR is a virtual reality multiplayer competitive shooter. Emphasizing tactical gunplay, high-caliber combat, and collaborative teamwork. Introducing the ultimate VR shooter experience.
